activity.notes: Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte succeeded Charles XIII on 5 February 1818 and ruled the union as Karl XIV Johan of Sweden and Karl III Johan of Norway until his death on 8 March 1844. ATLAS keeps his stable biographical identity under Bernadotte while recording the royal office and union polity in this Activity.
